steps.instruction: Rename the Todo field `done: boolean` to `completed: boolean`. Make no other changes to Todo or Command. Update your own tests and any code in this unit that uses `done`. If an existing test uses `done` and can't compile any more, ask for a test change: update the field name only and keep what the test asserts.

The Todo field `done` from ./types is renamed to `completed` (Todo is now { id: number; title: string; completed: boolean; due?: string }). Wherever you read `todo.done`, read `todo.completed` instead. Rendered output must stay exactly as it is. If an existing test builds Todo objects with `done` and can't compile any more, ask for a test change: rename the field only and keep the expected output the same.

The Todo field `done` from ./types is renamed to `completed` (Todo is now { id: number; title: string; completed: boolean; due?: string }). save must write `completed` to the JSON file and must not write a `done` key. For backward compatibility, load must also accept older files where a todo has `done` but no `completed`: map it to `completed` and drop `done` from the returned objects. If an existing test uses `done` and can't compile any more, ask for a test change: rename the field only.

The Todo field `done` from ./types is renamed to `completed` (Todo is now { id: number; title: string; completed: boolean; due?: string }). add must create todos with `completed: false`. complete must set `completed: true`. list must filter on `completed`. Do not rename ListOptions.includeDone; keep its meaning, which is to include completed todos. All output text stays the same. If an existing test uses `done` on Todo objects and can't compile any more, ask for a test change: rename the field only and keep what the test asserts.

input.reason: The rename changes the shared Todo interface in types. format, storage and commands each read or write that field, so all four units need updating in parallel. To avoid scope creep, output text and ListOptions.includeDone stay the same. storage will still load older JSON files that use `done`.
